summary: Density labels are composition intent; gate capacity with observed Chromium readability checks and retain detailed quality failure evidence.
invariants: Allow low, medium and high density intents in one deck when every slide passes measured capacity and readability checks.
Missing or failed Chromium capacity, readability or observation-binding checks remain fail-closed.
Keep original provider content and density intent immutable; do not force label uniformity to obtain a pass.
Retain detailed generation quality receipts in attempt/fence-bound execution evidence, separate from the original IR checkpoint.
forbidden: Using density label variety alone as a visual-quality defect
Treating one product-path success as a general aesthetic or production-readiness guarantee
